name: code-review-reports
description: Produces an evidence-based code quality workbook (.xlsx) for a repository, scored against Review Criteria supplied at invocation time. Bundles two skills — react-code-review (grounded in Vercel React performance rules and Cognine React coding standards) and node-code-review (grounded in Node.js Best Practices and OWASP Top 10) — sharing one 12-column findings-sheet shape, a Threshold Mapping sheet that states the rule behind every severity, one rubric set, and one pre-delivery validation gate.
